heading_en: Review of Rating Criteria and Rating Assignment Procedures, etc.
summary_ja: 格付及びプールの基準並びに付与の手続を、資産構成と外部状況への適用可能性の観点から定期的に見直す。
summary_en: Requires periodic review of rating and pool criteria and procedures for their applicability to the current asset composition and external environment.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall periodically review the rating and pool criteria and the procedures for assigning ratings and allocating to pools, in order to determine whether those criteria and procedures are sufficiently applicable to the composition of the entire current assets of that Ultimate Designated Parent Company, etc. and to the external environment.
